title: 공증사무 이의신청사건의 처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Notification of Results and Notice of Objection Procedure)
(1) When an objection case has been handled, the chief prosecutor of a district prosecutors' office shall notify the objector and the notary public concerned of the result and shall report the result in writing to the Minister of Justice with copies of supporting documents attached.
(2) When notifying the objector of the result, the chief prosecutor shall inform the objector that an objection may be filed with the Minister of Justice if the objector contests the result.
